name: Wind Surge

stealth.note: (expert) to note stirrings in the wind

description: Hurricane-force winds rip through the area as Agyra flies past.
disable: DC 27 Athletics (expert) or DC 27 Acrobatics (expert) to crouch and contort out of the wind's way (disables the hazard for only yourself), DC 30 Survival to point out a safe space from the winds for up to 3 creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hurricane Flyby
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Agyra flies overhead for at least 120 feet in a straight line

Effect Supernaturally powerful winds batter the area in a line that is 120 feet long and 30 feet wide and 30 feet tall. Each creature in the line must attempt a Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save. Moving above ground against the direction of the line is greater difficult terrain for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is pushed 10 feet along the line.

Success The creature takes 5d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage and is pushed 15 along the line.

Failure The creatures takes 10d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage, is pushed 30 feet along the line, and is knocked Prone.

Critical Failure The creature takes 20d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage, is pushed 45 feet along the line, is knocked prone, and is Stunned 1 for 1 round.

If the line overlaps a body of water, the winds cause massive waves that deal 6d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage to creatures in the water or within 15 feet of the waterline (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save). On a critical failure, a creature is also swept 30 feet away from the waterline and 15 feet beneath the water's surface.
